title: Sleek in-viewer PDF with Exit back to video
description:
View PDF from the pipe chart now opens a sleek full-panel PDF viewer inside the media window. Use Exit (or Escape) to close it and return to the video without leaving the workspace.

Who is affected: PipeShare users reviewing pipe inspections on the private server, and on SaaS after Push.
changeLog: Pipe chart View PDF opens inside the media viewer with a clean Exit control.
Exit / Escape closes the PDF overlay and restores the video.
Pipe-run photos use the same overlay chrome for a consistent handoff.
